title: HKDF iterations field not rejected when non-zero — silent mismatch
description: fd.c:1704 enforces iterations >= 1000 only when algo starts with 'pbkdf2'. For HKDF algos, a non-zero iterations value is silently ignored. UAPI doc says 'Ignored for HKDF (set to 0)' — this is documentation advice, not enforcement. A user who accidentally passes iterations=500 with hkdf(sha256) thinking they are getting a 500-round KDF will get plain HKDF with no error and no warning. Maintenance consequence: this will generate user confusion issues ('I set iterations=500 and it succeeded') and the answer is non-obvious. Fix: reject iterations \!= 0 for HKDF algos with -EINVAL, or emit pr_warn_once. Simple check: strncmp(op.algo, 'hkdf', 4) == 0 && op.iterations \!= 0.
